title: Ventral dermatitis in rowi (Apteryx rowi) due to cutaneous larval migrans
author: Gartrell, B.D.
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Visualise PCR products on gel
steps.instruction: Load the PCR products amplified from rowi tissue samples using nematode‑specific primers NC1 and NC2 onto a 1% agarose gel. Include a DNA ladder in lane 1, rowi samples in lanes 2–6, a control using the LD plasmid in lane 7, a positive control with Haemonchus contortus DNA in lane 8, and a negative water control in lane 9. Run the gel under appropriate conditions and image the bands.
